item.title: Judge blocks Arizona criminal case against Kalshi at CFTC request as CFTC names prediction markets a focus of new Innovation Task Force, BitRss reports — Oct 26, 2026 · 3:00 PM ET
item.description: - **Judge blocks Arizona criminal case against Kalshi at CFTC request as CFTC names prediction markets a focus of new Innovation Task Force, BitRss reports** — A federal judge issued a temporary restraining order pausing Arizona's criminal case against Kalshi, which faced 20 counts of unlawful wagering and election betting, after the CFTC sued to stop state enforcement against federally registered prediction markets, BitRss reported. The CFTC also unveiled the first lineup of its Innovation Task Force, naming contracts and prediction markets among its three central innovation areas. ([BitRss](https://bitrss.com/cftc-expands-crypto-team-after-court-blocks-prediction-market-ban-200298))
